verdict.rationale: Stripe's testing docs say the test-mode authentication flow shows only Stripe-managed test institutions, and accounts from any of them can be linked without real credentials. A community user also confirms being routed to the test dashboard, so the sandbox-linking core of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: evidence that test institutions return balance, ownership and transaction data in test mode; documented ways to trigger error states (failed logins, inactive accounts, relink); independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end test run.
